categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Matches 'Build system' label and directly edits Guix build scripts under contrib/guix/libexec/.
categories.rationale: Fixes inconsistent source paths in Guix debug symbols by mapping the entire DISTSRC root rather than just DISTSRC/src. As noted in the description, generated source files previously retained container paths in debug symbols, making source directory mapping in debuggers difficult.
